how can I transform my MSstats data to MSnSet? I can not find the function transformMSstatsToMSnSet in the MSstats package. If that is not possible what would you suggest to do PCA, volcanos or heatmaps? I am quite new to R and proteomics data analysis.

messages.author: ce683b307e5b88d5
messages.subject: Re: MSstats to MSnSet - is it possible to transform the data for visualization purposes?
parts:
msstats comes with a variety of build in visualization functions

check out the documentation:
https://msstats.org/wp-content/uploads/2020/02/MSstats_v3.18.1_manual_2020Feb26-v2.pdf

for example:
  groupComparisonPlots gives you volcano plots

heatmaps are a little further down in the documentation....


As for PCAs, I think there is currently nothing available to adress this in msstats?

Best Klemens
